cohort: Singleton infants born late preterm via cesarean delivery to mothers who did not receive antenatal corticosteroids
finding: In this cohort of late preterm infants born via cesarean delivery to mothers who did not receive antenatal corticosteroids,  neonatal respiratory morbidity decreased with increasing gestational age.
mod_finding: This study found that late preterm infants born via cesarean delivery before labor to mothers who did not receive ACS had an increased need for ventilation, especially those born at 34 and 35 weeks.
